title: Content Pack Manifest, Component Identity & Typed Payload Contract
objective: Establish the governed CNI content-pack manifest, stable component identity and typed payload contract needed for later dependency, narrative and cross-pack interoperability work.

scope.purpose: Create the first CNI pack/dependency foundation without taking authority from narrative, Action/Event or ARI owner domains.
scope.completion_gate: A deterministic content-pack manifest with stable component identity and typed payload validation compiles and round-trips through governed tooling without direct owner-domain mutation or duplicate resource identity.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json is the cross-program sequence authority and makes CNI eligible after SMB-07, MIB-18 and ARI-22C.
CNI does not become canonical Story or owner-domain state authority.
CNI packs reference ARI resource identity/rights rather than duplicating the resource library.
Narrative/runtime changes must bind to governed Actions/Events rather than directly mutate owner-domain state.
CNI-01 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists yet.
CNI-02 and later CNI work, PCA and later programs remain unauthorized until their roadmap/tranche gates are satisfied.
SMB-08 remains planned and is not selected until required studio/runtime golden barriers are satisfied.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue to governed-start CNI-01; do not implement while selected_not_started.
